## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?

> e.g. "When monitoring large flocks, it's impossible to manually check all cameras. A heatmap overlay would make it much easier to spot crowding anomalies."

## 📐 Proposed Solution

Describe how you imagine this working. Include any mockups, diagrams, or examples if possible.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered?

## 🧩 Affected Components

- [ ] Backend (Python/Flask)
- [ ] Vision AI pipeline
- [ ] Frontend (React)
- [ ] Mobile (React Native)
- [ ] Infrastructure (Docker/Supabase)
- [ ] Plugin system
- [ ] Documentation

## 📋 Additional Context

Any other context, links to research papers, or references.
